questions.solution:
Total cost price of 15 mangoes = ₹210

20% mangoes were rotten
Rotten mangoes = 20% of 15 = 3

Remaining mangoes = 15 − 3 = 12

Selling rate: 12 mangoes for ₹240
So, selling price of remaining 12 mangoes = ₹240

Cost price = ₹210
Selling price = ₹240

Profit = 240 − 210 = ₹30

Profit % = (Profit / Cost price) × 100
= (30 / 210) × 100
= 14.29%

Final Answer: 14.29% profit
